name: phi-spaces-codemode-forum
description: Next.js 16 + React 19 codemode forum: at least three AI models develop one plan together in a phi-space, until a majority agrees it can be carried out

scripts.docker:test: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test run --rm --build codemode-forum-test
scripts.docker:image: docker build --network host -f docker/Dockerfile --target production -t phi-spaces-forum:prod ..
scripts.docker:local:up: NANO_CPUS=${NANO_CPUS:-2} PORT=${PORT:-4110} FORUM_SPACE_BIND=127.0.0.1 FORUM_SPACE_PORT=4190 docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-local --profile nano --profile big up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:local:down: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-local --profile nano --profile big down
scripts.docker:local:logs: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-local --profile nano --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:local:backup: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-local --profile nano exec space node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types server/backup.ts
scripts.docker:image:rust: npm run docker:image && docker build --network host -f docker/Dockerfile --target production-rust -t phi-spaces-forum:rust ..
scripts.docker:rust:up: NANO_CPUS=${NANO_CPUS:-2} PORT=${PORT:-4110} FORUM_SPACE_BIND=127.0.0.1 FORUM_SPACE_PORT=4190 docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-rust --profile nano --profile big up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:rust:down: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-rust --profile nano --profile big down
scripts.docker:rust:logs: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml -p phi-spaces-forum-rust --profile nano --profile big logs -f
scripts.docker:nano:up: echo 'big and nano run only the Rust implementation (R-D12): npm run docker:nano:rust:up' && exit 1
scripts.docker:nano:rust:up: npm run docker:image:rust && docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml --profile nano up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:nano:rust:down: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml --profile nano down
scripts.docker:nano:rust:logs: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.rust.yml --profile nano logs -f
scripts.docker:big:up: npm run docker:image && docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile big up -d --no-build
scripts.docker:big:down: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile big down
scripts.docker:big:logs: docker compose $([ -f .env ] && echo --env-file .env) -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile big logs -f
